notes.title: Patch v3.4.0.3
notes.content:
Added cooldown animations for selected skills. Cooldowns are currently designed to be GLOBAL so any skill you use, your crutarch must wait until the previous skill's cd is finished cooling down.

Hold down "T" key by default to bring up the skill selection mini menu.

1. Fireball now costs 250 stamina, cooldown is 3 seconds. Damage 250.

2. Icicles now cost 200 stamina, cd is 2 seconds, damage 125.

3. Shock costs 225 stamina, cd is 2.5 seconds, damage 150.

4. Obscure costs 300 stamina, cd is 1.5 seconds, summons a visually distorted ethereal barrier to visually distract players.

5. Light Medicine costs 150 stamina, cd 5 seconds, heals self for 50hp.

6. Light Energize costs nothing, cd 10 seconds, restores 200 stamina instantly to self.

7. Medic class skill changed. Summon a medbox, which casts an aura healing anyone for 15 hp per 1.9 seconds, including enemies. Medbox expires after 14 seconds. CD 6 seconds.

8. Support class skill changed. Summon an ammobox, restoring a large amount of ammo every 1.9 seconds, including enemies. Expires after 14 seconds. CD 6 seconds.

9. Assault class skill changed. Summon a revitalizer, restoring 95 stamina every 1.9 seconds inside aura, including enemies. Expires after 14 seconds. CD 6 seconds.

10. Scout class default skill remains unchanged (jet booster).

11. Leveling system is implemented but is bugged and doesn't affect game play yet. EXP gained is gained by completing actions or scoring kills (not implemented yet), starting with a level up requirement of 500xp then 20% for each next level.

12. Major UI improvements.

Things to do next patch:

1. Fixing up the leveling system.

2. EOS or player data storage on the cloud will be in a couple of patches. Once this is implemented, we can start having permanent player progression with faction bases and a tarkov style pvpve looter.

3. We'll start adding item drops per win/loss on official dedicated servers to start testing.

4. Making a game design decision, for now, to not have stamina drain on sprinting. We'll see how that affects the incursion looting mode (pvpve) later on.

notes.title: Patch v3.4.0.2 Notes
notes.content:
1. Added footsteps to walking and running.

2. Walk, run, and crouch movement speed is slower.

3. No footstep sounds when crouch moving. You're completely silent.

4. Faction name changes. The rebellion is known as the "Crutarch Insurgency" or nationalist faction. The imperial empire is known as the "Templari Imperium".

5. Weapon damage now inflicts stamina damage.

6. Weapon sounds now correctly adjust to your sound effects volume settings.

7. New Skill Mini Menu Added. Press and HOLD "T" Key By Default To Access.

8. Improved mouse cursor.

9. Jump Height Improved.

10. 4 New skills added, currently it has no cost or cooldown timer but for testing purposes be set like this until we figure out the balance values. It *will* be changed next patch.

11. Fireball added, deals 250 damage on single hit. Stamina cost will be 250 next patch.

12. Icicles added, deals 125 damage on single hit. Stamina cost will be 200 next patch.

13. Shock added, deals 150 damage on single hit. Stamina cost will be 225 next patch.

14. Obscure added, summons a wall that distorts a small area in front of you. Will cost 650 stamina but will likely change next patch.

Future updates are planned for improving and then overhauling the UI to be more clear about weapon and skill stats.

Things To Do Next Patch v3.4.0.3:

1. Sprinting now drains stamina. Run carefully!

2. Adding a few more skills and class specific skills.

3. Costs to using skills.

4. In round leveling system.

5. Probably some other stuff.

notes.title: Patch v3.4.0.1 Now Live
notes.content:
Changes are mostly cosmetic but we'll begin working on the Stamina / Energy system, which forms the basis of all gameplay. You may see some changes to the UI but stamina won't begin to affect your character, yet.

Expect changes to walk speed, meaning you will move a lot slower and have to sprint to get around, costing stamina. This will be the aim of patch v3.4.0.2.

1. All maps except vehicle map have been expanded. We'll continue changing and adding to the maps. Themes are desert and rock, green landscape, and snow. Performance should still be good but let us know if FPS is bad after this update. NO eta on vehicles but it is planned and it occurred to us we could make vehicles have an energy system with unique skills. That's something no other game has done before, we think.

2. Increased conquest map to 5 capture points, up from 3. Score required to win is now 600, up from 300.

3. Rush map now has 8 objectives, with 2 at a time per "phase" for a total of 4 phases. First 2 are hardest to defend but the last 2 are located right in the defending team's spawn point, making it the most difficult to bomb.

4. Stamina system foundation in play. Skills now cost a certain amount of stamina / energy to use, in addition to the ability cooldown timer.

5. New main menu and main theme music. Youtube will have the free version of it online for your infinite 10 hour looping pleasure. Edit update: You can find it here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2KBgGMIiOVs Enjoy! 

[previewyoutube=2KBgGMIiOVs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

6. Will add the new main theme music to the soundtrack. Be sure to pick it up now because we are going to raise prices on the next addition of music. Get the free upgrades now.

7. Added out of bounds play area. No trying to sneak to the edge of the map!
